title: Concept: Order settled at zero value
description: An order total of zero next to a priced item in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A zero total next to a real item means the pricing step trusted a client value, so the same path can usually be pushed to a chosen price instead of zero.
applicability: Deployments that render an order total of zero next to a priced item into a customer- or partner-facing response.
